title: US equity, options and bond markets closed — Christmas Day (Friday 2026-12-25, the day itself, behind a real 1:00 p.m. ET half session)
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200 after its 302 — the page needs curl -L — 109,180 bytes) and parsed cell by cell by this session, which is the CANONICAL file written by the christmas-market-closure-2026-12-25 initial research after reading the single sibling proposal for this id. The page states 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028'; its Christmas Day row parses as ['Friday, December 25****', 'Friday, December 24 (Christmas Day observed)', 'Monday, December 25'] for 2026 / 2027 / 2028, so 2026 is a FULL closure on the day itself, with no observance shift. Footnote **** reads verbatim: 'Each market will close early at 1:00 p.m. (1:15 p.m. for eligible options) on Thursday, December 24, 2026. NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions will close at 5:00 p.m. All times are Eastern Time.' CORROBORATED FROM TWO FURTHER PRIMARIES THE SAME SESSION. (1) The OCC's own expiration calendar (www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) marks 2026-12-25 {"holiday":{"description":"Exchange/OCC holiday","hatched":true}}, and marks 2026-12-31 a 'Quarterly Expiration date' (legend GUID 812CD242-1E6F-48D4-A1CB-9608ABD8344F, decoded this session). That marker is load-bearing rather than decorative because the same file keeps a SEPARATE vocabulary for the bond-only days when equities stay open — 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-11 are labelled 'Bank holiday' and are not hatched — so 'Exchange/OCC holiday' is the file's own term for a full closure. (2) SIFMA's US Holiday Recommendations panel (sifma.org/resources/guides-playbooks/holiday-schedule, HTTP 200, 299,272 bytes) gives the 2026 Christmas row a FULL US fixed-income close on 'Friday, December 25, 2026' with 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Thursday, December 24, 2026'. Reproduced independently by statute and weekday arithmetic: 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes Christmas Day on December 25, and December 25 2026 is a FRIDAY, so it is observed on the day with no Friday-to-Thursday or Saturday-to-Friday shift. THE TREASURY-AUCTION CROSS-CHECK THAT THE SIBLING PROPOSAL ASKED FOR WAS RUN AND IS UNAVAILABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, not blocked: api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov auctions_query returned HTTP 200 on 2026-09-08 but publishes only ANNOUNCED auctions, and the latest bill auction in the series is 2026-09-10 — the labor-day-market-closure-2026-09-07 technique (a Monday bill slate shifted to Tuesday as mechanical third-party proof of a closure) is retrospective only and cannot date a closure 108 days out. Re-run it at close-out. Filed estimate on the two counts every sibling closure entry documents (labor-day-market-closure-2026-09-07, good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26, memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31, thanksgiving-market-closure-2027-11-25, christmas-market-closure-2027-12-24): the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts, and this lane's own no-self-confirm limit. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by this id's own initial research (2026-09-08), which read the one sibling proposal first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md — proposals/christmas-market-closure-2026-12-25.from-sp-select-sector-secondary-reweight-2026-12-31.json — and then fetched every primary rather than inheriting its statute-only derivation. The proposal is correct on the date and correct that no exchange calendar had been read; this session read three. THE SESSION BUDGET IS THE OPPOSITE OF THE INTUITION, and matches what the 2027 sibling found for its own year: December 2026 carries 22 SESSIONS, tying the 1990-2025 record maximum (range 19-22, counted off FRED's NASDAQCOM session record), because 23 December weekdays less the single 12-25 closure is 22. Verified 5 of 5 against every prior Friday-Christmas December in the record — 1992, 1998, 2009, 2015 and 2020 are all 22-session months. But 2026 is the SHORTEST 22 by hours: 21 full sessions at 6.5h plus the 12-24 half session at 3.5h is 140.0 equity hours, against December 2027's 22 x 6.5 = 143.0. A lane budgeting December 2026 should use 22 sessions and 140 hours, never a decremented short-month template. THE CLOSURE'S REAL COST IS RELEASE COMPRESSION, AND IT IS MEASURED, NOT ASSERTED: the last FULL session before the break, Wednesday 2026-12-23, carries four CONFIRMED US macro prints — pce-2026-12-23 (high), gdp-q3-2026-third-2026-12-23, durable-goods-2026-12-23, new-home-sales-2026-12-23 — making it one of only 8 dates out of the 90 in this calendar that carry any confirmed entry to carry four or more, and one of the top three by confirmed high/medium impact. Then Thursday 12-24 is a 3.5-hour session with zero scheduled US prints, Friday 12-25 is dark, and the tape does not reopen until Monday 12-28. The same shape repeats at this year's other closure — Wednesday 2026-11-25 carries FIVE confirmed prints ahead of the 11-26 closure and the 11-27 half day — so the stacking is structural, not a coincidence of one corridor. CROSS-ASSET GUARDS IN THE CORRIDOR, both dated: on Thu 2026-12-24 NYSE closes equities at 1:00 p.m. ET (options 1:15) while SIFMA recommends US fixed income close at 2:00 p.m. ET, so bonds OUTLIVE equities by an hour — the inverse of the common shape, already recorded by christmas-eve-half-day-2026-12-24. On Thu 2026-12-31 NYSE runs a full equity session that is also the year's last, the OCC marks it a quarterly expiration, and SIFMA recommends a 2:00 p.m. ET bond close — with a real holiday behind it, Friday 2027-01-01 (NYSE's 2027 column), which is the inverse of 2027, where the year-end early close sits in front of no holiday at all. Impact low and symbols empty: a scheduled full closure known 108 days ahead moves no price and licenses nothing; its value is that flow arithmetic across the year-end corridor counts sessions correctly. Kind sector matches every sibling closure entry — the imperfect enum fit for a market-structure event is named, not fixed from this lane. Estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
